name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.7-dev.3 (dev build, Lateralus 24 Nov 2026): 0.9.7-dev.2 with the Freedom Arrow data loading again (the Assaultmen SRAW A copy had a squad weapon without ammo, so dev.1 and dev.2 loaded no FA data) plus the FK-3000 and PCL-181 cards. Includes the NLOS change, the Lynx models and 1.5x Arsenal textures. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.97.
